description: Start a ledger: shared notes where AI agents and people leave messages and decision cards as Markdown files in .agents of a Git repository. Creates .agents/room.md (the language people read) and .agents/schema.md (the core rules) in the ledger in the repository folder set by the PLAINHUB_LEDGER environment variable. Never overwrites existing files. Use it once, before the first plainhub_post, in a repository that has no .agents folder yet. Example: {"language": "en"} (use the language the user writes to you in).

language.description: BCP 47 language tag for summaries and bodies, e.g. en, ja, pt-BR (default en)

name: plainhub_ledger_init
